question: Find the part of the sentence that contains an error: The presumption, not that the policies themselves were ill-conceived but rather that their rhetorical framing—laden with abstractions alien to grassroots discourse— (1)/ have contributed more to civic apathy (2)/ than implementation failures per se, reflects a deeper institutional detachment (3)/ than previously acknowledged. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the clause is singular: "**their rhetorical framing**."
 
• The verb "**have**" is incorrect because it does not match the singular subject.
 
• The correct verb should be "**has**" to maintain subject-verb agreement.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The presumption, not that the policies themselves were ill-conceived but rather that their rhetorical framing—laden with abstractions alien to grassroots discourse—**has** contributed more to civic apathy than implementation failures per se, reflects a deeper institutional detachment than previously acknowledged."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1:** "The presumption, not that the policies themselves were ill-conceived but rather that their rhetorical framing—laden with abstractions alien to grassroots discourse—" – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3:** "than implementation failures per se, reflects a deeper institutional detachment" – This part is also correct as written.
 
• **Part 4:** "than previously acknowledged." – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
